descricao_original: The outer boundaries of osteons are marked by cement lines. Cement lines have a high concentration of ground substance and, therefore, appear as basophilic bands around the osteons. Cement lines mark the transition between resorption and new growth, as well as indicating interruptions in a growth pattern, similar to tree rings. 200x
